violation_type.title: Furnishings and Equipment for Pre-Kindergarten Age - Age-appropriate (26 TAC §747.2505(1))
violation_type.short_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Pre-Kindergarten Age - Age-appropriate
violation_type.typical_finding: A 4 year old child was seen sleeping in a crib at the operation.

finding_variants.text: A 4 year old child was seen sleeping in a crib at the operation.

The home is not equipped with equipment that allows children the opportunities for thinking and sensory development, small and large muscle development, language development, social and emotional development.
